pages.title: Stop when the chest is full
pages.text: A Sensor Item Node compares the total number of items in its attached inventory with a chosen number. Select a comparison and an output color.$(br2)Use the slider or its single arrows for the threshold. The outer double arrows decrease or increase it by 10.$(br2)For a refill system, make a sensor on the destination turn green when its total is below your target. Require green on the source Output Node.

pages.title: Using colored conditions
pages.text: The labeled row has two $(thing)Positive$() and two $(thing)Negative$() selectors. A sensor only contributes its output when every selected positive color is on and every selected negative color is off. A gray X leaves a condition unused. If several sensors use one output color, any true sensor makes that color true.$(br2)The sensor counts $(thing)all items$() in its inventory. Use a dedicated material chest for a simple stock target. These colors belong to the field; they do not select a flux type.
